title: 每日温度
statement: 给定整数数组 temperatures 表示每天的气温，返回数组 answer：answer[i] 是从第 i 天起，至少还要再等几天才会出现严格更高的气温；如果之后都不会更高，answer[i] = 0。

en.title: Daily Temperatures
en.statement: Given an integer array temperatures representing the daily temperatures, return an array answer where answer[i] is the minimum number of days after day i you must wait to get a strictly higher temperature; if no later day is warmer, answer[i] = 0.

complexity.space: O(n) extra space (monotonic stack, excluding the returned array)
complexity.notes: n is the number of days. Maintain a stack of indices whose temperatures are non-increasing; when a new temperature is higher, pop repeatedly and fill in the waiting days. Alternatively, scan right to left and jump using already computed answers. The O(n²) approach of scanning forward from each day times out when many temperatures are equal. The official limit is n = 10^5, but both input and output must be stored in the problem bank, so the largest local test is reduced to n = 50000 (all equal, all answers 0, specifically targeting the forward-scan approach).

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: line 1 is n; line 2 has n integers temperatures. stdout: one line with n integers answer, separated by spaces.

complexity.space: O(n) 额外空间（单调栈，不计返回数组）
complexity.officialRequirement: 官方未强制复杂度要求。
complexity.notes: n 为天数。维护一个下标栈，对应气温单调不增；新气温更高时依次弹栈并填写等待天数。也可从右往左利用已求出的 answer 跳跃查找。逐日向后扫描的 O(n²) 做法在大量相等气温时会超时。官方上限 n = 10^5，但输入与输出都需写入题库，本地最大测试缩小为 n = 50000（全部相等，答案全为 0，专门卡逐日向后扫描）。

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：第一行 n；第二行 n 个整数 temperatures。stdout：一行 n 个整数 answer，空格分隔。
